errors.text_span: across three tiers—Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3—in an ABS-AOS pattern
errors.evidence: The figure does not contain any labels or visual groupings for "Tiers". This information is hallucinated, likely from the external paper caption, and incorrectly applied to the visual structure of the chart.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the tiers, labeled “Tier-1”, “Tier-2”, and “Tier-3” in sequential order.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis has no labels. The chart shows 12 individual, unlabeled bars, not categories labeled "Tier-1", "Tier-2", and "Tier-3".

errors.text_span: ranging from 0 to 61.09, with tick labels at intervals of 10
errors.evidence: The vertical axis scale does not range from 0 to 61.09; it extends beyond 60. The tick labels are at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60), not 10.

errors.text_span: There are three bars for each tier
errors.evidence: The chart does not show grouped bars based on tiers. It displays 12 individual, ungrouped bars. This statement invents a grouping structure that does not exist.

errors.text_span: filled with a light gray color
errors.evidence: The bars are not all light gray; they are distinctly multicolored, including shades of green, purple, blue, pink, and brown.

errors.text_span: For Tier-1, the bars reach heights of approximately 61.09, 48.28, and 48.83. In Tier-2, bar heights are approximately 60.72, 48.83, and 27.22. Lastly, Tier-3 displays bars reaching heights of approximately 54.83, 43.79, and 46.36, diminishing to 44.09, 40.87, and 43.54.
errors.evidence: This entire section describes data organized by hallucinated tiers. The assignment of specific bar values to these nonexistent tiers is a complete fabrication. Furthermore, it is internally inconsistent, assigning six bars to Tier-3 after claiming there are three bars per tier.

The horizontal axis does not have any category labels. The description incorrectly interprets the data values, which are annotated on top of each bar, as labels for the x-axis categories. Furthermore, the list of values is incomplete (missing 61.09, 60.72, 43.54), contains a hallucinated value (47.54), and incorrectly implies there are 10 bars when there are 12.
The visible tick labels on the y-axis increment by 20 (0, 20, 40, 60), not 10.

errors.text_span: Each category is represented by a single bar of a light gray color.
errors.evidence: The bars are multicolored, including shades of green, purple, blue, brown, tan, and pink. Only one of the twelve bars is light gray.
The tallest bar in the chart has a value of 61.09%, not 60.72%.

errors.text_span: No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
